paths.reason: A preflight node, a wave-planning node and a scope-resolution node each edit a different region of this file, so a whole-file claim serialises work that does not actually collide.
The promotion path and the review-gate checks are separate concerns, and nodes repairing one rarely touch the other.
Resume, death-row classification and stream measurement are independent repairs against one file.
Each MCP op or view lands in its own handler, so two nodes extending different ops edit disjoint regions of a large file.
CLI verbs are added by independent nodes at separate call sites and in separate subcommand groups.
Derived roadmap facts and the surfaces that read them are extended by independent nodes at separate points in the module.
